description: Single-command install: new root setup.sh one-liner (curl | bash) for fresh VPS machines, and install.py --run now auto-installs dependencies (pip install -e .) and starts the console on 0.0.0.0:7777 — the old 5-step manual flow collapses into one command.
features: setup.sh one-liner: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X5Coder/X5Agent/main/setup.sh | bash (clones or fast-forward updates ~/X5Agent, passes flags through to install.py, --no-run opts out of auto-start).
install.py --run: installs then replaces itself with the console server on 0.0.0.0:7777 (+ --public passthrough) so install+start is one step.
install.py auto-dependencies: missing sentence_transformers/numpy now trigger one bounded pip install -e . instead of failing with a manual instruction.
README: one-liner documented first, manual flow shortened to git clone + install.py --run.
Version synced to 0.8.0 in server APP_VERSION, pyproject.toml and updates.json.
